title: Review deliberately forgotten Rust values
why: mem::forget skips destruction and can permanently retain memory or external resources.
suggestion: Use normal ownership, ManuallyDrop, or an explicit resource transfer contract.
limitations: The rule uses masked source tokens and does not perform Rust type resolution.

Targeted allow or expect policies for clippy::mem_forget or mem_forget are honored on the attributed item or expression, including multiline reasons and scoped inner attributes. Other lint policies, comments, and strings do not suppress findings.
Intentional shutdown leaks and manual ownership transfers without an explicit targeted policy remain review findings; comments do not prove correct destruction.
